subject: Forecast needle check + RYG ownership for Solstice Health
body:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Torres <anna@solstice-health.com>, sourcing@procurecorp.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast needle check + RYG ownership for Solstice Health

Hi Anna / procurement team —

Quick forecast check ahead of next week's commit lock (June 2): please confirm current stage and any outstanding gating items for the Solstice Health opportunity (RDW-4981). We're showing this as yellow in the tracker but I want to make sure our internal owners and the save-plan are aligned. Attached: RYG_tracker_Solstice_RDW-4981.csv and SOW_Solstice_v1.docx for your reference.

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm whether Solstice still plans to issue PO this quarter and if so, expected PO date?
- If there are open procurement questions, who is the owner there and what is the blocker?
- If you need an exec intro to speed review, tell me and I'll escalate.

Internal owners (tentative): Marissa (account exec) — commercial follow-up; Marcus (solutions) — final SOW clarifications; Naomi (finance) — billing/PO acceptance.

Deadline: please reply with status by EOD Mon 31-May so we can lock forecast adjustments for Q2. If any items fall into red, include a short save-plan (owner + 3 actions + ETA).

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0149

---

From: Anna Torres <anna@solstice-health.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:42:13 -0400
Subject: Re: Forecast needle check + RYG ownership for Solstice Health

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the note. Quick update from procurement at Solstice: we have internal legal review nearly complete but procurement needs confirmation on two billing terms (data residency clause and monthly billing cadence). Those are the gating items before PO. Our timeline is: legal sign-off by 6/3, procurement PO issuance by 6/10 if no additional changes.

At this point I would classify the deal as YELLOW — high intent, internal approvals in progress, PO not yet committed. If Redwood can confirm the two billing term options (we discussed the residency exception path and a monthly invoice alternative) I will push for the earlier PO.

If helpful, I'll include our procurement lead on follow-up — that would be Susan (susan@solstice-health.com).

Anna
Anna Torres
Head of Product Partnerships, Solstice Health
anna@solstice-health.com | +1 (617) 555-2201

Attachment: procurement_timeline_v1.xlsx (referenced)

Thanks Anna — useful clarity. My proposed save-plan for RDW-4981 (if Solstice stays YELLOW):

1) Commercial owner: Marissa Cole — immediate ask to Anna: confirm procurement contact (Susan) and loop her into the SOW clarifications by EOD Mon 31-May.
2) Technical unblock: Marcus Lin — provide a 30-minute SOW Q&A focused on data residency language and monthly billing alternative. Target: complete by Wed 2-Jun.
3) Finance: Naomi Feldman — prepare PO-ready billing addendum and a one-page note on revenue recognition for Solstice procurement. Target: draft by Tue 1-Jun.
4) Escalation: If PO not issued by Thu 10-Jun, Hannah to request an exec-to-exec check (I can provide briefing).

Why this should move to green: once procurement has the billing addendum and legal sign-off (Anna's 6/3 target), PO issuance is procedural. The goal of the save-plan is to remove the two billing questions swiftly and surface the PO path.

I'll take ownership of point #1 today. Marcus — can you confirm available slots for a short call tomorrow or Wednesday AM? Naomi — can you confirm you have the standard billing addendum template? Hannah — if you agree I will update the hubspot deal notes and mark the tracker with owners/dates.

Perfect — thanks team and Anna. Quick summary & next check-in cadence: 

- Current RYG: YELLOW (internal tracker updated).
- Owners & deadlines: Marissa (procurement intro) — 31-May; Marcus (SOW Q&A) — target 2-Jun; Naomi (billing addendum) — draft 1-Jun.
- HubSpot: I've updated RDW-4981 with the save-plan and linked the RYG tracker (see related links).
